evidence: PDF p. 16: "ILLUSTRATIVE — a chosen scenario input or worked example ([canonical scenario] or [ILLUSTRATIVE], paired with ASSUMPTION or DERIVED), on the book’s teaching geometry, to be re-derived per deployment; this is a provenance tag (Axis 1) only, not a measurement status"; same page: "Axis note: [ILLUSTRATIVE] is a provenance tag (Axis 1) only — a non-canonical worked example — and is never a measurement status".
issue: The evidence taxonomy contradicts itself inside the same paragraph. ILLUSTRATIVE is first defined as including [canonical scenario] and as being on the book’s teaching geometry, but the Axis note immediately says ILLUSTRATIVE is non-canonical. This can cause load-bearing labels to be read under the wrong provenance rule.
fix_instruction: Remove [canonical scenario] from the ILLUSTRATIVE definition and remove 'on the book’s teaching geometry' as a defining condition. State that [canonical scenario] and [ILLUSTRATIVE] are distinct Axis-1 provenances and that ILLUSTRATIVE covers non-canonical worked examples only.

evidence: PDF p. 58, Fig. 3.2 caption: "Convention: the source box’s fixed tokens are drawn outside the canvas; cells show output positions only, and accepted IDs extend the prefix." Panel B is titled "B Full-canvas masked sampler: accept selected IDs" and shows the intermediate state "A ? C ?".
issue: The figure convention says accepted IDs extend the prefix, but panel B explicitly shows a full-canvas masked sampler accepting selected IDs out of order. A and C are accepted while B remains unresolved, so the accepted IDs do not form a contiguous prefix. The caption therefore misdescribes the convention for one of the three panels.
fix_instruction: Qualify the convention: say accepted IDs extend the prefix only in the autoregressive and valid block-causal panels; in the full-canvas masked panel, accepted IDs become fixed resolved positions and do not necessarily form a prefix until finalization.

evidence: PDF p. 5: "Full terms: github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet (LICENSE, SPDX LicenseRef-ZhiqiResearch-FromTokenToFleet-1.0)"; later: "The link above resolves that commit’s LICENSE file directly, so the terms quoted here can be read in their exact published form without locating the revision elsewhere."
issue: The visible link text points to the repository root and parenthetical LICENSE name, not to the pinned commit’s LICENSE file, yet the prose says the link resolves directly to that file. A reader following the visible URL cannot read the exact pinned terms without manually substituting the commit path.
fix_instruction: Either print the direct URL to github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/<commit>/LICENSE or change the sentence to say that the repository link leads to the revision where the LICENSE file can be found.

chapter: Ch. 5 — From Workload to Model Selection
evidence: PDF p. 119: "At ~50 tok/s aggregate throughput, the effective cost is ~$0.40 per (tok/s) per hour"; later on the same page: "the ~50 tok/s used here is a deliberately low-batch (single-stream) generation rate — conservative against batched serving rates".
issue: The same 50 tok/s quantity is first called 'aggregate throughput' and then clarified as a low-batch single-stream rate. 'Aggregate' misleadingly suggests batched or whole-fleet throughput, which is exactly the interpretation the following reconciliation note warns against.
fix_instruction: Replace the first phrase with 'single-stream host generation rate' or 'single-stream 50 tok/s operating point', and reserve 'aggregate' for explicitly batched or fleet-wide token rates.

chapter: Ch. 7 — Memory Is the First Constraint
evidence: PDF p. 166: "At the deployed integer slot count C = 17, a rank holds 140 ÷ 8 = 17.5 GB of weights + 8 GB of runtime/NCCL + 17 × 3.11296 = 52.92 GB of KV = 78.42 GB, or 98% of its 80 GB — workable, with ~1.6 GB of headroom."
issue: The chained equality makes 52.92 GB of KV appear to equal the 78.42 GB rank total. The arithmetic is correct when read with an implied parenthesis, but the sentence violates one-meaning-per-expression clarity and can be misread as an arithmetic error.
fix_instruction: Rewrite as two sentences or add parentheses: 'The KV term is 17 × 3.11296 GB = 52.92 GB. Adding 17.5 GB of weights and 8 GB of runtime/NCCL gives 78.42 GB total.'
